description: Crash repro (2026-10-02, camera-cycle census run 132035 on i76.exe): the game died with 0xC0000005 about 1 s after B (toggle_binoculars, camera_mode 2, per-frame 0x4071a0) pressed in the cockpit after a second F1 (which flips 0x654b88, 2D dash <-> 3D cockpit). This repro presses B first in the plain cockpit (3 s), B off, then F1 (flip), B again (3 s), B off. No census: separates the exe from the hooks.
